svg.title: Technology stack — what runs where
svg.desc: Study Buddy Matcher design diagram. Editable source: docs/diagrams/render_diagrams.py. Supplementary text and notation are in docs/diagrams/README.md.

g.text: Every library, tool and hosted service the project uses, grouped by the tier it runs in. Versions are the ones in the README table.
Function components and hooks, one per file
DTO types mirror the API contract
Stateless filter chain and role checks
Signed tokens with role and version claims
Token exchange on the server, playback in browser
CC0 ambient sounds for the study room
Campus weather, cached with a fallback
Keys and client secrets stay on the backend;
the app still works when a service is down.
Interaction tests that reuse the Vite config
Tests what a user sees and clicks
Lint rules for React and TypeScript
34 tables, SQL migrations, row locks, RLS
Managed PostgreSQL shared by the team
Local demo database, disposable test database
Hibernate only validates it at startup.
Build, dependencies and the test run
Unit, slice and PostgreSQL integration tests
CI on every pull request and push to main
JDBC (the browser never reaches the database)
Top row = what runs while a student uses the app; bottom row = what stores the data and what builds, tests and delivers the code.
Brand marks: Simple Icons, CC0 1.0 (docs/diagrams/brand_icons.py). They are trademarks of their owners, shown only to name each technology.
Freesound and Open-Meteo have no mark in that set, so a neutral glyph is drawn. Mockito shares the JUnit tile for the same reason.
